summary_en: 290,500 shares (11.85% of S/O ex-treasury) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-04 at ¥5,930/share ceiling; ¥1,722.7M upper limit. Rationale: hedge market impact from Mitsui Metals' divestiture; concurrent capital-business alliance with Hulic and termination of Mitsui Metals technical partnership.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Matching Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Nakabohtec announced on 3 August 2026 that its board resolved to acquire up to 290,500 treasury shares via a single ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours matching) block transaction on 4 August 2026 at the previous day's closing price of ¥5,930/share, with a total ceiling of ¥1,722.7M. This represents 11.9% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury basis: 2,452,013 shares). The buyback is designed to mitigate market disruption from Mitsui Metals' divestiture of its entire holding in Nakabohtec. Concurrently, the company is executing a capital-business partnership with Hulic and dissolving its capital-technology partnership with Mitsui Metals. Results will be announced following the transaction window.
